checks.explanation: Eric Adams won the 2021 New York City mayoral election.
Crime remained a dominant political issue across the United States for years following mid-2021.
Multiple significant SARS-CoV-2 variants (Delta, Omicron, and its many sublineages) emerged over the following years.
The Omicron variant emerged in the fall of 2021 and drove a severe winter 2021-2022 COVID wave, as predicted.

The COVID lab-leak origin theory gained substantial credibility and additional information emerged over subsequent years, but a definitive proven 'cover-up' with escalating revelations has been contested and not conclusively resolved.
Small-scale, code-driven local vaccine production technology has advanced but has not been widely deployed at scale within the predicted decade window, which has not fully elapsed.
This prediction concerns competitive dynamics through around 2031, a timeframe not yet elapsed; Amazon and Apple have so far remained dominant.
This prediction concerns a 10-15 year window extending through the early-to-mid 2030s that has not yet elapsed.

Cancel culture dynamics have shifted significantly (including changes to Twitter/X's moderation approach), but discourse remains highly polarized and contentious rather than clearly having broadly opened up as predicted.
There is no public record available to verify the relative body weights of David Sacks and Jason Calacanis by the end of summer 2021.
